merge-pdf.title: Merge PDF
merge-pdf.intro: Combine several files in the order you chose.
steps: Drop the files you want to merge into the panel
Reorder them in whatever order you like

faq.q: Does the file leave my computer?
faq.a: No. Everything runs in your browser.

prose-a.title: Merge several documents into one file
prose-a.desc: Combine several separate documents into one single file in the order you choose yourself.
prose-a.intro: Merging copies the page objects of each file into one document without rasterising them, so text stays selectable.
steps: Drop the files you want to work with into the panel on the left
Choose the order they should appear in and press the button

faq.q: Does the merged file keep the original bookmarks and links?
faq.a: Yes, both sets of references are rewritten so they still point at the right page.
